['Viessmann Werke GmbH & Co. KG'].company_description: The Viessmann Group is a German manufacturer of heating and refrigeration systems headquartered in Allendorf (Eder), Germany. The company operates internationally with 22 production companies in 12 countries, distribution companies and representative offices in 74 countries, and 120 sales offices worldwide. Viessmann is family-owned and was founded in 1917. The company employs 14,500 people and reports annual sales of €4 billion. Its product range includes heating and refrigeration systems, and it is a global leader in this sector.
